gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Codes for why reinforcement is present over a given interval of a rigid inclusion column - tension zone, bending, seismic, or an ASIRI-defined domain. ASIRI (Amelioration des Sols par Inclusions Rigides), the French national research project whose recommendations underpin much RI design practice, defines a domain classification for column behaviour; asiri_domain_1 names the domain this project's source material cites, not a full restatement of ASIRI's own domain criteria - confirm the exact domain definitions against the ASIRI recommendations before relying on this entry for design review, same caveat this project already attaches to diggs:archingModel. Used for the value of diggs:ReinforcementType/diggs:reinforcementPurpose.
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Rigid Inclusion Reinforcement Purpose Codelist Definitions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Reinforcement resisting net tensile stress over this interval, most commonly near the column head.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Tension zone

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Reinforcement resisting flexural (bending) demand over this interval.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Bending

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Reinforcement provided for seismic ductility or capacity demand rather than static design alone.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Seismic

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Reinforcement provided per the ASIRI national project's Domain 1 classification - confirm exact criteria against the ASIRI recommendations; not independently verified here.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: ASIRI Domain 1
